h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Belgaum

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Belgaum

items.pText: Belgaum, or Belagavi, sits on the Karnataka side of the border with Maharashtra and Goa. It is greener and cooler than most of north Karnataka, and its monsoon is long and heavy. FunPlay Systems is about 430 km away at Vasai, close enough for regular deliveries by road. We supply outdoor playground equipment to Belgaum's schools, cantonment-area colonies, housing societies and parks.

Months of rain bring a problem that buyers in dry towns rarely see. Moss and algae grow on shaded surfaces, and wet leaves pile up under trees. Roto-moulded plastic does not rot or rust, and galvanised steel posts resist corrosion, but a damp, shaded slide can become slippery. We help you choose a spot that gets some sun after the rains, and we explain at handover how to clean the equipment through the wet season.

richText.heading: Keeping play equipment clean through a long Belgaum monsoon

c: Choose a site with open sky above it if you can, and avoid putting slides directly under dense trees. Leaves and constant drip keep surfaces wet and invite moss.

Through the rains, scrub slide beds and steps with water and a soft brush every week or two. Avoid wire brushes, which scratch roto-moulded plastic and make it easier for dirt to stick. Lay rubber flooring on a sloped, drained base so water runs off quickly. Low-maintenance pieces like a

items.q: How do we stop playground slides getting slippery in the rains?
items.a: Place them away from dense tree cover, and scrub them with water and a soft brush every week or two through the monsoon. That keeps moss and algae from building up on the surface.

items.q: How far is your factory from Belgaum?
items.a: Our factory in Vasai East, near Mumbai, is about 430 km from Belgaum. We send equipment by road and install it with our team or a dealer in Karnataka.

items.q: Is rubber flooring suitable for a very rainy town?
items.a: Yes, if it is laid on a firm base with a slight slope and a drain. Water then runs off quickly and the surface is ready to use soon after the rain stops.
